item.title: Inside the ultra-fast drone light show that closed CES 2026
item.description: As CES 2026 wrapped up in Las Vegas earlier this month, the spotlight didn’t stay inside the convention halls for long. Instead, it moved to the night sky, where 1,200 drones rose above the Strip in a tightly choreographed light show that quietly set a new bar for how efficiently large drone performances can be pulled off in the US. more…

item.title: New DJI Mini 4K deal makes drone flying ridiculously affordable
item.description: If you’ve ever thought, “I really should buy a drone” — or needed a gift that genuinely impresses — this might be your moment. The DJI Mini 4K, one of the most beginner-friendly drones money can buy, has just dropped to record-low prices, undercutting its usual retail cost by a wide margin. more…

item.title: Humans vs. AI drones: The finish came down to one mistake
item.description: What happens when the world’s fastest human drone pilots line up against AI systems built to think, react, and fly at extreme speed — using almost no sensors? You get the A2RL Drone Championship, where split-second decisions, not flashy hardware, decided who ruled the sky. more…

item.title: Yes, your DJI drone can still get firmware updates — FCC confirms
item.description: If you fly a DJI drone, here’s the answer you actually came for: yes, your drone can still receive firmware updates in the US. And yes, that was very much in doubt until now. more…

item.title: Antigravity A1 drone gets first-ever discount with new flight simulator feature
item.description: Antigravity’s groundbreaking A1 drone, the world’s first consumer 8K 360° aerial camera drone, is stepping into the spotlight with its first major discount and a significant feature update — a flight simulator built right into its immersive Vision Goggles system. The new tools and price cut aim to entice both first-time pilots and creative pros to experience a fresh way of flying and capturing the world. more…

item.title: SkyeBrowse launches AI-powered 3D modeling system for faster drone mapping
item.description: SkyeBrowse, one of the fastest-growing 3D modeling platforms in the drone mapping space, has unveiled a major suite of upgrades designed to help public safety agencies and investigators process crash, crime, and emergency scenes faster than ever — with minimal manual work. more…

item.title: New DJI RS 5 makes advanced camera moves easier than ever
item.description: DJI is back with a new tool aimed squarely at creators, and this time, it’s all about working smarter, lighter, and longer. The company has officially launched the DJI RS 5, a brand-new lightweight commercial gimbal designed to give videographers more stability, faster setup, and surprisingly powerful intelligent tracking without adding bulk. more…

item.title: DJI Mavic 4 Pro gets smoother control with latest firmware patch
item.description: If you fly a DJI Mavic 4 Pro, this is one of those updates you’ll want installed before your next takeoff — not because it adds flashy new features, but because it quietly improves the things drone pilots notice most once they’re in the air. more…

item.title: New DJI Matrice 400 firmware improves LiDAR, battery reliability
item.description: DJI has rolled out a fresh firmware update for the Matrice 400, bringing a series of under-the-hood improvements aimed squarely at enterprise operators who depend on precision, stability, and reliability in demanding environments. While this isn’t a flashy feature-packed update, it addresses some of the most critical aspects of professional drone operations: positioning accuracy, sensor performance, and battery safety. more…

item.title: How to safely operate DJI Dock 3 during harsh winter conditions
item.description: Winter doesn’t pause critical drone operations, but it does raise the stakes. As DJI Dock 3 continues to roll out across public safety, infrastructure inspection, utilities, and industrial monitoring, operators are increasingly relying on it in cold, windy, and low-visibility environments.
